title: Computing statistical Euler limits of the Navier--Stokes equations in three dimensions
summary: We develop a Monte Carlo lattice Boltzmann method to compute statistical solutions to the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes and Euler equations. Entropic space-time adaptive relaxation of the higher order kinetic moments yields stable numerical solutions with decreasing viscosity. We provide a convergence analysis that is conditional on four explicitly stated assumptions regarding the discrete dynamics.
